blurb: The Clinton Historical Society preserves Clinton’s history in a collection of museums including our historic house museum - the 1750 Elisha White House known as “Old Brick.” We also maintain the George Flynn Library, the Buell Tool Museum, historic gardens, and the Museum Room in Clinton’s Town Hall.
